$notes_s1: S1: include serving_ap (per-UE int), sinr_db, per_user_rate_bps_hz (len=4), sum_throughput_bps_hz, mean_throughput_bps_hz, fairness_index.
$notes_s2: S2: include scheduler='proportional_fair', alpha, num_slots, instantaneous_rate_bps_hz (len=4), scheduled_ue (len=T), per_user_throughput_bps_hz (len=4), sum_throughput_bps_hz, fairness_index.
$notes_s3: S3: include az_grid_deg (3 values), sweep_table (9 rows with az1_deg, az2_deg, rate_ue1, rate_ue2, sum_rate), best (az1_deg, az2_deg, sum_rate).
$notes_s4: S4: include total_rb, per_user_se_bps_hz (len=4), sweep_table (5 rows with strategy, allocation (len=4), per_user_rate_bps_hz, sum_rate, fairness), pareto_set (list of integer indices).
$notes_all: All four S* tasks MUST call sionna.rt.PathSolver to get per-(AP, UE) path gain. SINR / scheduling / Pareto math is closed-form on top of those gains; sionna.phy is NOT required (network-level, not PHY-link).
